items.en: Displaced Palestinians protest as Israeli air strikes continue in Gaza
items.zh: 加薩流離居民抗議，以軍空襲未歇
items.summary: Displaced Palestinians staged protests in Gaza as Israeli air strikes continued and residential buildings were destroyed. A Gaza mayor described the demolitions as part of a policy of gradual displacement, pushing families further from their original neighbourhoods. Aid access remains constrained and shelter is scarce for those moved repeatedly, with local officials warning that each new wave of strikes deepens an already severe humanitarian emergency across the territory.

items.en: Iran targets US military in Bahrain as Houthi strikes continue
items.zh: 伊朗攻擊巴林美軍設施，青年運動持續襲擊
items.summary: Bahrain condemned Iranian strikes on US military assets on its territory, saying an attack caused a fire at an industrial facility with no reported injuries. Iran's Revolutionary Guard said it targeted US positions at two bases, al-Riffa and Awali. Houthi forces kept up strikes that have left Saudi Arabia on edge, while Iran said it held talks with Qatari mediators and urged Washington to accept its conditions.

items.en: Deadly attack in Kyiv as Russia launches barrage against Ukraine
items.zh: 俄軍大規模空襲，基輔至少七人死亡
items.summary: Russia launched more than 400 drones and 110 missiles at targets across Ukraine overnight, killing at least seven people in Kyiv. Emergency crews worked through damaged residential districts as air defences engaged incoming waves. The barrage is among the largest of recent weeks and renews pressure on Ukraine's power and heating infrastructure as winter sets in, with officials warning of further strikes on energy sites.

items.en: Clashes erupt across France in another night of protest
items.zh: 法國連續第六週末爆發示威衝突
items.summary: French police charged to disperse crowds on Saturday as the country faced a sixth consecutive weekend of demonstrations. The protests sit alongside wider European marches over living costs and housing, including rallies in Portugal, and follow youth-led actions over education and economic hardship. Organisers say pressure will continue, while the government faces mounting questions over policing tactics and the cost-of-living response.

items.en: Trump says he wants 'permanent' deal to stop Iran getting nuclear weapons
items.zh: 川普稱要與伊朗達成「永久」核協議
items.summary: US President Donald Trump said he wants a permanent agreement preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapons, speaking as strikes continued across the Gulf. Iran's foreign minister said reopening the strait would not be difficult if Washington accepted reasonable conditions, after talks with Qatari mediators. Lebanon's president separately demanded an Israeli withdrawal while criticising Iranian interference in Lebanese affairs.

items.en: FBI national crime database suffers suspected breach: Reports
items.zh: FBI 全國犯罪資料庫疑遭入侵
items.summary: Reports say the FBI's national crime information database suffered a suspected breach, the latest in a string of hacks and outages affecting US federal systems. The database underpins law-enforcement record checks nationwide, so any exposure raises questions about the integrity of criminal records and the security of data shared with state and local agencies. Officials have not confirmed the scale of the intrusion.

items.en: S&P 500 falls to seven-month low as tech and AI concerns fuel sell-off
items.zh: AI 疑慮擴散，S&P 500 跌至七個月低點
items.summary: The S&P 500 slid to a seven-month low on Friday as doubts over AI spending and chip demand drove a broad technology sell-off. Losses spread from semiconductor names into the wider market, dragging the Dow into correction territory alongside the Nasdaq. Investors pointed to stretched valuations and uncertainty over how quickly AI capital expenditure converts into earnings as the main triggers for the retreat.

items.en: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items.zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, two deployments of the same underlying model, priced at eight dollars per million input tokens and forty dollars per million output tokens. Fable is open to all users with safeguards, while Mythos is restricted to vetted organisations. The company reports gains on coding and agentic benchmarks and says outputs run up to thirty percent faster than Fable 5.1.

items.en: Noni Madueke salvages draw for Arsenal at Newcastle United as Raya injured
items.zh: 馬杜埃克救平局，阿森納客場遭紐卡逼和
items.summary: Noni Madueke rescued a draw for Arsenal away at Newcastle United, with goalkeeper David Raya picking up an injury during the match. The result means the league leaders missed the chance to move eight points clear of second-placed Brighton, who play on Sunday. Arsenal's title cushion narrows just as their goalkeeping depth comes into question ahead of a congested winter schedule.

items.en: Chelsea beaten 4-1 by Leeds to suffer third loss in four in Premier League
items.zh: 切爾西主場 1-4 不敵利茲聯
items.summary: Leeds United came from a goal down at Stamford Bridge to beat Chelsea 4-1, climbing above their hosts into sixth place in the Premier League. It is Chelsea's third defeat in four league matches and deepens the pressure on a side that began the season among the title contenders. Leeds, by contrast, have turned a difficult start into a run that now puts them in European contention.

items.en: Liverpool vs Manchester United: Premier League - teams, prediction, lineups
items.zh: 利物浦對曼聯，英超宿敵再戰
items.summary: One of football's biggest rivalries takes centre stage as Liverpool host a Manchester United side sitting in the Premier League relegation zone. Al Jazeera previews likely line-ups and tactical questions for both managers, with United needing points far more urgently than the fixture's history suggests. The gulf in league position makes this one of the most lopsided meetings between the two clubs in years.

items.en: Reading for pleasure linked to a 33% lower risk of Alzheimer's
items.zh: 閱讀習慣與阿茲海默風險降低 33% 有關
items.summary: Research summarised by ScienceDaily links reading for pleasure with better memory, lower stress and improved mental health, including a thirty-three percent lower risk of Alzheimer's disease. The report also cites findings that as little as five minutes of fiction can cut stress by up to twenty percent. The association does not prove causation, but researchers argue sustained reading is a low-cost habit worth protecting.

items.en: For better mental health, how often you exercise may matter more than how hard
items.zh: 運動頻率比強度更影響心理健康
items.summary: In a study of more than ten thousand college students, how frequently people exercised predicted mental health outcomes better than workout intensity or duration. Students who exercised less often were more likely to report depression and anxiety a year later. The authors suggest that for students juggling coursework, building a regular but modest routine may matter more than chasing hard sessions.

items.en: Too much exercise could leave your brain stuck in overdrive
items.zh: 過度訓練可能讓大腦持續亢奮
items.summary: In mice, prolonged intense training left dopamine elevated in a brain region tied to memory and emotion, with the effect still measurable forty-eight hours later. The researchers suggest the pattern may relate to the insomnia, anxiety and fatigue reported by overtrained athletes, though those symptoms were not measured directly in the study. The work points to a recovery window that heavy training schedules may overrun.

items.en: Chips suffer worst week since 2001 as the Nasdaq nears a bear market
items.zh: 晶片股寫 2001 年來最慘單週，那斯達克逼近熊市
items.summary: Semiconductor shares posted their worst week since 2001 as the Nasdaq 100 approached bear-market territory, with the AI trade unwinding across chip designers, memory makers and equipment suppliers. The slide wiped out the index's gains for the year and left the Philadelphia semiconductor index down about ten percent on the week. Investors are reassessing how much AI capital spending is already priced in.

items.en: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon on the paid API
items.zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Neon，僅開放付費 API
items.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon on November 18, listed at three dollars per million input tokens and fifteen dollars per million output, available on the paid API only. It joins Gemini 4 Carbon, which reached general availability earlier in the month at promotional pricing that rises on December 1, and Gemini 4 Hydrogen. Third-party benchmark scores place Neon below Carbon on the same evaluation board.

items.en: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra at 20% below its predecessor
items.zh: OpenAI 推 GPT-6.2 Astra，價格較前代低 20%
items.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra on November 17 at eight dollars per million input tokens and forty per million output, about twenty percent below the previous Astra tier, and replaced GPT-6.1 Sol with a cheaper GPT-6.2 Sol. The company also shipped GPT-Live-1.1 in the API on November 19. Independent benchmark boards currently rank Claude Fable 5.2 narrowly ahead of GPT-6.2 Astra.

items.en: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour reaches the Tokyo Dome in December
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema 世界巡演 12 月進東京巨蛋
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour, supporting his all-English third album Prema, runs through Japan this December with Kyocera Dome Osaka on December 10 and 12-13 and Tokyo Dome on December 19-20. The tour already played Kaohsiung National Stadium on October 31 and Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka in mid-November. Dates listed come from an April announcement, so check the official site before booking.

items.en: Prema World Tour adds Bangkok and Seoul; Hong Kong show cancelled
items.zh: 藤井風加場曼谷、首爾，香港場取消
items.summary: The Prema World Tour added Supachalasai National Stadium in Bangkok on December 26 and Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul on January 9, 2027, while the planned Hong Kong show was cancelled. A summer 2027 leg is planned for Europe and North America, with Cologne, London, Paris, Chicago, Los Angeles, Mexico, New York, San Francisco and Toronto named but not yet dated.

items.en: King Gnu announce a 2027 US tour with Los Angeles and New York dates
items.zh: King Gnu 宣布 2027 美國巡演，含洛杉磯與紐約
items.summary: King Gnu announced a 2027 United States tour including stops in Los Angeles and New York, extending the band's overseas touring after a run of arena and dome shows in Japan. No Taiwan or Hong Kong date has been announced alongside the US leg. Fans in Asia watching for a regional extension should monitor the band's official channels for additional announcements.

items.en: YOASOBI set for two nights at Taipei Dome in 2027
items.zh: YOASOBI 2027 首登台北大巨蛋連唱兩天
items.summary: Taiwanese media report YOASOBI will play two consecutive nights at the Taipei Dome in 2027, the duo's first shows at the venue, with ticketing details and seating maps circulating ahead of the on-sale date. The booking places YOASOBI among a run of large international acts scheduled for the stadium next year. Confirm the exact dates and ticket windows through the official promoter.
